verdict.rationale: File transfer between host and viewing device is a fair question for a remote desktop product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions file transfer, drag-and-drop, or a clipboard file copy feature. The pack documents only streaming, input devices, monitors, privacy mode, collaboration and Teams administration, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a power user, I can transfer files between the host and the viewing device inside a session
